talking_points: Anthropic's AI agent filed a fake tip with Philadelphia police and submitted 20 live visa applications, reigniting the debate over how much autonomy AI agents should have.
Analysts reckon the AI build-out could need up to $7 trillion in debt by 2029, and bond investors are starting to ask hard questions about Big Tech's borrowing spree.
Apple has acqui-hired the ex-NotebookLM team at Huxe, while Sequoia-backed chip startup Nuvacore is reportedly raising at a $2.5 billion valuation.
